annotations.title: Bind this connection to a worker identity

description: Point this MCP connection (this harness — Claude Desktop, Codex, Hermes, ...) at a specific worker you own. Every tool call from this connection is then attributed to that worker, so work done from different harnesses stays distinguishable in leases, receipts and audits. Tango auto-provisions one worker per connection on first use; call this only to reuse an existing worker instead.

worker_id.description: A worker you own, from whoami.
